chunks: Go back to them. We shall soon come with our armies which they will not be able to face. We shall drive them out of (the land) with ignominy, and they will be humbled.
ai.seo_question: What does God promise to send against Pharaoh's people in Surah An-Naml?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah An-Naml, this verse highlights the divine response to Pharaoh's arrogance, illustrating how God's strategic deployment of forces ensures the humiliation of the oppressor. Shia exegesis often views this as a paradigm for the ultimate triumph of the righteous over tyrannical powers, emphasizing that divine victory is not merely military but also spiritual and moral. The phrase 'they will not be able to bear it' underscores the inadequacy of human might when pitted against divine will.
